compile_rasp_to_model: compile a RASP program to transformer weights with a given vocab and max sequence length
validate_rasp_program: validate a RASP program to detect unsupported expressions before compilation
extract_rasp_graph: extract a computation graph from a RASP program for further compilation steps
infer_bases: infer basis directions for nodes in a RASP computation graph
add_craft_components: add craft graph components like BOS and MLP approximations to a RASP graph
